metadata.description:
Bold, provocative, and never afraid to experiment, the Walker Art Center is a beacon for contemporary art lovers. It challenges, surprises, and sometimes even confuses—but that’s exactly the point. Whether inside the galleries or wandering the adjacent sculpture garden, you’re part of the conversation. Collect this Culture Collector POAP and honor your curiosity in the 612 POAP Challenge. 

Category: Culture Collector 
GPS: 44.96848, -93.28869
